title: Mini raptors — Apus Mini, Alcotan, Gavilan: three first-guess designs on a 5-inch racing stack

meta.method: first principles and empirical correlations; no CFD, no FEA; conceptual CAD

rows.Apus Mini: economy: one wing a third of a gate wide, two of the stack's motors, the hover pitch by the elevons in the slipstream
rows.Alcotan: the chaser: sustained speed on 6S and the 5x5, the motors at the tips of a +
rows.Gavilan: tight spaces: the racing frame's motor square in a short cell, the wing as a brake
